pages.text: Five mods rebuild the biomes (BetterNether, Bygone, Soulful, Jaden's, Formations) and two rebuild the buildings (YUNG's Fortresses, Moog's Structures).$(br2)$(bold)My Nether's Delight$() adds Nether cooking. $(bold)Bartering Station$() trades gold with piglins by itself. $(bold)Nether Chested$() puts chests on striders.
New gear and ores from BetterNether: $(bold)Cincinnasite$() and $(bold)Nether Ruby$().
Get ancient debris and go $(bold)netherite$(). Then $(bold)Advanced Netherite$() upgrades netherite gear with iron, gold, emerald and diamond tiers. Look up $(bold)@advancednetherite$() in JEI.

The $(bold)Wither$() (4,000 HP) and the $(bold)Warden$() (6,000 HP) are your next real fights. The Warden matters: it drops the Heart of the Deep, which opens the Otherside.$(br2)Careful: the Nether also has Cataclysm's $(bold)Netherite Monstrosity$() (12,000 HP). Leave it for later.
